About Dublin

Dublin is a literary, pub-loving city on the Liffey — Georgian streets, lively music and centuries of history within easy reach of green coastline.

Best time to visit Dublin

The sweet spot is generally May–Sep — and the cheapest fares often land just outside peak season.

Top things to do in Dublin

  • See the Book of Kells at Trinity College
  • Tour the Guinness Storehouse
  • Hear trad music in Temple Bar
  • Visit Kilmainham Gaol
  • Walk the coast to Howth

Good to know

Very safe. Language: English. Visa for US passports: Visa-free, 90 days.
